title: Rescue-quality signal
finding: A3 rerun at leave-one-document-out thresholds: no candidate passes G1 to G3. Hosted Jev (wording chosen per document) catches 56/89 junk, routes no usable document, flags 12/565 healthy pages against an 11-page ceiling. Jev AUC 0.878 to 0.922; Julia 1 stays near 0.5 across three wordings and two input lengths. A (word check) catches 37/89 but routes usable `rf05`. Cascade word check then Jev: 50/89, 28% of pages sent, fails G2 on `rf04`. No production change
